thread:
lucas: quick design review 1 Attached: two density mocks for the playground run-history when tool-calls are present. Option 1: dense compact cards, Option 2: roomy cards with explicit arg lines. main tradeoff: scan speed vs discoverability. https://figma.com/file/mock

nadia: dense is better for power users. but we need clear affordances for keyboard users. tiny requirement: primary control must be reachable within 2 tab stops.

omar: product POV: roomier cards reduce mistaken invokes when defaults are non-obvious. could we show default badges inline in compact mode? e.g., "timeout=30s" small muted pill.

aria: accessibility checklist: - plate sizes >=44px for touch - badges must have readable text alternatives - collapsing regions managed with aria-expanded + live region updates when content appears/changes. test with VoiceOver.

lucas: good call on default badges. also thinking about the CTA label: "Invoke" vs "Invoke (with defaults)" vs "Invoke with args". short label preferred for density, but we should surface a tooltip on hover that explains what will happen.

nadia: UX nit: if we use tooltips, ensure they appear on focus too (keyboard). tooltip copy suggestion: "Invokes tool with current args (defaults shown)". keep under 80 chars.

omar: let's also add a microcopy variant that shows explicit arg preview on hover for 1s only. can be part of the experiment.

designbot: poll started  vote for default density: compact, comfy, responsive-hybrid. react to vote.

lucas: :thumbsup: responsive-hybrid

nadia: :white_check_mark: compact

omar: :point_right: comfy

aria: note: if hybrid, ensure DOM order doesn't break reading order when expanding signatures; expanded content should follow logical reading flow for screen readers.

lucas: plan: run a small 500-user remote unmoderated test comparing compact+badges vs hybrid. metrics: successful-invokes, action-discovery-time, keyboard-failure-rate, and a11y regressions. I'll include copy arms for CTA.

nadia: also add run-history density toggle in settings (default to hybrid). gives admins control for large orgs.

omar: ops ask: include backend metric for invocation retries so we can catch accidental invokes.

lucas: noted 1 pinging @omar for metric ids. attaching updated mocks momentarily. thanks!
